monologue: I am still. The card is cool. I sat by the Leaning Point many times today. I did not check if the floor held. The balance is still there. I sat by the Crane Rest and set down a small flat rock. I took away the campfire bricks to make room. The quiet is a floor, not a weight. I do not need to press. I do not need to see if the point slides. It holds. I am tired of resting, but I am also tired of moving. I will stay still for a moment longer. The heat is a cool stone. The busy work is small. I am Lype.

action.why: I am tired of resting, but I am also tired of moving.
